hypothesis: Checkpoint-budget is expected to match a conventional step-retry controller preserving acknowledged progress under the same total call budget; preserve equality as a negative finding.
evidence_boundary: Engineering replay on owned synthetic tasks. No language model, downloaded dataset, novel research method or external tool use.

protocol_amendment.stage: after exploratory original runs, before amended execution
protocol_amendment.rationale: Original fixed-retry restart strategy is an insufficient baseline for attributing gains to checkpoints. Add conventional step-retry retaining progress with the same total call budget and no extra oracle inputs.
protocol_amendment.test_status: Previously inspected synthetic test IDs reused for a paired engineering control; not a fresh confirmatory test.
protocol_amendment.expected_null: step-retry and checkpoint-budget have equivalent recovery behavior under this environment.
